title: Algebraic inverse images on stratum covering slices jointly reflect derived isomorphisms
statement: Let X be Noetherian [def-pc-scheme] and s a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification]. On every stratum choose a covering sieve of the terminal object in its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let L_α be set inverse images naturally isomorphic to the transported geometric inverse images of the actual stratum immersions [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], with left-exact left adjunctions and algebraic lifts F_α [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Supply algebraic lifts also for the actual slice restrictions and their adjunctions. For any commutative ring A and ideal I assume all canonical completed coefficient comparisons are isomorphisms. The composite derived module pullbacks to every arrow in every chosen stratum covering sieve jointly reflect isomorphisms of unbounded complexes over the completed coefficient ring.

source.place: Remark 6.5.10 and Proposition 6.6.11 reverse implication; Stacks Tags 09AH and 05RU

proof.text: Scalar extension along an isomorphism is an equivalence, so its adjunction unit and the prescribed insertion map are invertible. Underlying set sheaves commute with pure algebraic inverse image. Covering slice restrictions therefore detect zero modules: their zero objects have terminal underlying sheaves, and isIso_of_coversTop detects the map of the global underlying sheaf to the terminal one.

Identify underlying set inverse image with the underlying sheaf of abelian inverse image, by the canonical forgetful pullback comparison on the small models. Transport back to original sites. Finite quasi-compact jointly surjective stratum immersions detect zero maps by abDetectMaps. Apply this to the identity of the underlying abelian sheaf, then use faithfulness to detect zero modules.

The module adjunction and finite-limit preservation give exact module inverse images. Uniqueness of left derivation identifies the prescribed derived pullbacks with termwise exact localization. Exact-functor homology comparison and the preceding module result detect zero derived objects in every degree. A distinguished cone of a morphism vanishes if all its image morphisms are invertible; zero detection gives invertibility globally.

    (R : ∀ α : Fin s.n,

    (adj : ∀ α, L α ⊣ R α)

    (hL : ∀ α, Nonempty (L α ≅
      (AsSmall.up.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (ProEt.topology X) (proEtaleModelTopology X)) ⋙
      proEtaleSheafInverseImage (s.immersion α) (Type (u + 1)) ⋙
      (AsSmall.down.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (proEtaleModelTopology (s.domain α)) (ProEt.topology (s.domain α)))))
    (F : ∀ α, ConstantCompletion.InverseImageData (L α))
    [∀ α, IsIso (ConstantCompletion.completedMap (F α) A I)]

      ConstantCompletion.InverseImageData
        ((proEtaleModelTopology (s.domain α)).overPullback (Type (u + 1)) U))
    (W : ∀ (α : Fin s.n) (U : proEtaleSiteModel (s.domain α)),
      Sheaf ((proEtaleModelTopology (s.domain α)).over U) (Type (u + 1)) ⥤
        Sheaf (proEtaleModelTopology (s.domain α)) (Type (u + 1)))
    (adjW : ∀ α U,
      (proEtaleModelTopology (s.domain α)).overPullback (Type (u + 1)) U ⊣ W α U)
    [∀ α U, IsIso (ConstantCompletion.completedMap (G α U) A I)] :
    ∀ (M N : ConstantCompletion.D

      (∀ (α : Fin s.n) (U : proEtaleSiteModel (s.domain α))
